paragraphs.text: Book is an artifact type introduced in Secrets of Strixhaven . It is used for cards depicting a written or printed work consisting of pages glued or sewn together along one side and bound in covers.

The Book type has no inherent rules. Book cards also don't seem to have much mechanical consistency compared to previously introduced artifact types. Most books tend to do one of three things: draw cards , involve the hand / library , or have an effect linked to page counters .

Although atlases, books (including spellbooks and cookbooks), codices, diaries, folios, encyclopediae, grimoires, journals, manuals, and tomes have been featured as artifacts since Limited Edition Alpha ( Jayemdae Tome ), the type was only introduced in Secrets of Strixhaven to fit the flavor of the Biblioplex of Strixhaven . Unusually, Secrets of Strixhaven did not include any cards that interact with or reference the Book type despite being the set that introduced it. The set featured only one new card, Diary of Dreams , along with a Special Guest reprint of Codie, Vociferous Codex with an updated type line.
46 existing cards received the Book subtype through errata with the release of Secrets of Strixhaven . Following this errata, the oldest Book printed retroactively is Jayemdae Tome .
Additionally, three cards that make tokens representing Books also received errata to add the Book type to their tokens:
Tamiyo's Notebook (created by Tamiyo, Compleated Sage )
Volo's Journal (created by Volo, Itinerant Scholar )
Wasteland Survival Guide (created by Moira Brown, Guide Author )
